title: Decision (the frame the research serves)
description: v3: the loss is ELICITED from the human at run start (ordinal 4-rung ladder, ratio clamped [1,20]) and is T2-human-only; the engine may never edit it. If the user declines elicitation, the run degrades to EVIDENCE-MAP mode and no GO/NOGO conviction is emitted (loss_signed=false).

loss_signed.description: true only when a human signed the elicitation; false = evidence-map mode
